556:t_1:166.en:
$$チコ$$
「What was that...? A guy having hysterics?」

556:t_1:167.en:
$$ラルク$$
($$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me you...)

556:t_1:168.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you all right, $$シンジ$$?」

556:t_1:170.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$ seems to have been in a bit of a mood, hasn't he? Don't let it bother you.」

556:t_1:172.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Not knowing is a grave sin, isn't it?」

556:t_1:174.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But I think this is a good chance.」

556:t_1:176.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What that $$レナード$$ is trying to do... I find it very interesting.」

556:t_1:177.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$シンジ$$... I'm sure the next sortie will hold great meaning for you, too.」

556:t_1:179.en:
$$カヲル$$
「See for yourself and find out.」

556:t_1:186.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fifty-three meters in diameter... This is the core of 《$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$》, the largest in the world and the largest in history.」

556:t_1:187.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The Omnisphere Transposition Reaction Spacetime Communication Transformation Reactor... In other words, 《$$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$》.」

556:t_1:188.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It'll be up and running soon. The device that will repair this world.」

556:t_1:189.en:
$$レナード$$
「But $c will come... And $$テレサ$$ and $$相良宗介$$, too.」

556:t_1:190.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$? I killed them myself at $$ヤムスク１１$$, remember?」

556:t_1:192.en:
$$レナード$$
(That was only one of the possibilities you saw there... And yet you don't even doubt it...)

556:t_1:193.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The control code adjustments will be finished soon.」

556:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And then $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ will be complete. Its very existence is a revolution against fate.」

556:t_1:196.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll control the fate of humanity and lead the world myself. To a world that satisfies everyone.」

556:t_1:199.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sometimes I feel someone inside me who isn't me...」

556:t_1:200.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That someone blames me harshly, and seems to protest everything I do.」

556:t_1:201.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're just a little tired. You've been working nonstop since you came back from $$ヤムスク$$.」

556:t_1:202.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But that will be over soon, too.」

556:t_1:203.en:
$$レナード$$
「Focus on your own work. If it comes to that, I'll eliminate anyone who gets in the way.」

556:t_1:205.en:
$$レナード$$
「Objectively speaking, about ninety percent.」

556:t_1:206.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Could it be you're not confident?」

556:t_1:207.en:
$$レナード$$
「Our opponent is the strongest unit on this planet. If we fought ten times, even I might lose once.」

556:t_1:209.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm always humble. Anyway, that's how it is, so I'd like you to hurry as much as you can.」

556:t_1:210.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even for a mere ten percent chance, I want to be prepared.」

556:t_1:211.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Got it. But it's almost done.」

556:t_1:212.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A quiet, transparent, gentle world will arrive in just a little while. Passing through the netherworld, to the infinite sky that opens up beyond it... I'm sure you'll be able to see it, too.」

556:t_1:215.en:
$$レナード$$
「I want to see you over there, too... in the new world. In any form at all.」

556:t_1:216.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure. On a nice sunny day, in some peaceful town, let's have a long, relaxed cup of tea.」

556:t_1:217.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I know! Let's invite $$テッサ$$ to tea, too.」

556:t_1:218.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That girl is close with you and knows nothing about war. The three of us can have a fun chat.」

556:t_1:219.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll get to see my friends from school, and Mom, too. Everyone's doing fine... And this time, I'll finally be happy.」

556:t_1:220.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Aren't you going to see him?」

556:t_1:223.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's about time I began preparing that thing.」

556:t_1:224.en:
$$レナード$$
「First I'll use it to open a crack in the dimensional boundary... in the very way the world exists.」

556:t_1:225.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Be careful. That thing is hard to handle.」

556:t_1:227.en:
$$レナード$$
「That I would welcome. Though the one to deal with it would be $c.」

556:t_1:228.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well then... I'll leave the rest to you.」

556:t_1:229.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The 'him' that $$レナード$$ was talking about...)

556:t_1:231.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Why couldn't I remember right away? He was supposed to be someone so precious to me...)

556:t_1:232.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Is the guilt of shooting him dead with my own hands trying to make me forget him...?)

556:t_1:233.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...How stupid. I killed him in a sham reality. Once I go to that other world, he'll be alive and kicking.)

556:t_1:234.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I want to, I can see him anytime. As long as I finish this plan safely and save the world...)

556:t_1:235.en:
$$かなめ$$
(So let's hurry... I'm... going to save the world...)

556:t_2:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If that power can save the world, I'll become a god or anything else...)

556:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The three goddesses who govern fate... I am Clotho, and Lachesis, and Atropos...)

556:t_2:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(A world that can't be accepted... events that must be denied... I will take all of it on, cherish it, and transform it.)

556:t_2:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(From now on, forever... until everyone can be satisfied...)

556:t_2:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The transformation of the world, now...)

556:t_3:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
(With a strong voice that reaches far away... all the way to the past...)

556:t_3:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(To turn this warped world into a peaceful one where no one gets hurt, I'll reweave the twisted, crumbling fabric... with threads of this voice...)

556:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Start over... Everything, from that day eighteen years ago...)

556:t_3:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I do, by the time I turn eighteen, I'll be living happily with my family, enjoying high school life with my classmates at school, and...)

ヤムスク.evidence: Bare form of the glossary keyword ヤムスク１１ (Yamsk-11), the research city; 201: Leonard says Kaname has been working nonstop since coming back from Yamsk.

kept_omissions: 556:t_1:172: Kaworu's 知らない has no object; kept as generic 'Not knowing' (presumably Nicola not knowing Shinji's/others' feelings).
556:t_1:227: そちら/その相手 left as vague 'that'/'it' (Kaname's unfinished 'if you slip up...' is not spelled out).
556:t_1:218: あの子 rendered 'That girl' (Tessa, per the previous row).
556:t_1:187: the reading gloss （タルタロス） after 《ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ》 dropped (redundant in English; the keyword link is kept).
uncertain: Bare ヤムスク (t_1:201) proposed as new name $$ヤムスク$$ = Yamsk (glossary only has ヤムスク１１ = Yamsk-11); orchestrator may prefer $$ヤムスク１１$$.
t_1:187: Omnisphere Transposition Reaction Spacetime Communication Transformation Reactor is my literal rendering of オムニスフィア転移反応時空通信変容炉; no official English found.
t_1:190/218/229-235: Tessa = $$テッサ$$, Sousuke = $$宗介$$ (Kaname), but Leonard's テレサ/サガラ・ソウスケ = $$テレサ$$ / $$相良宗介$$ (t_1:189).
t_2:6: Clotho/Lachesis/Atropos written as plain English (Greek Moirai), not tokens; glossary has no entry.
t_1:172: reading of Kaworu's line (ignorance is a grave sin) refers to Nicola's outburst, inferred from neighbouring slice 01.
t_1:227: そちらは大歓迎だ referent unclear; kept vague.
Caption rows (t_1:184, t_2:3): ～ $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ Core ～ with the token used outside a 《》 link; indent 8 fullwidth spaces is a guess at centering.
t_3:8 ??? '(...No...)': speaker is the hidden inner voice; 違う could also be '(...That's wrong...)'.
